gaps.criterion: All nine SOP roles provisioned as persona role facets and rebac templates
gaps.gap: All nine are DEFINED and the provisioning call is real, built against the payload shape the SDK catalog publishes (app_id, name, permissions, tenant_id for POST /api/role-templates; role for POST /api/personas/:persona_id/role) rather than a guessed contract - the catalog resolves those endpoints now, which it did not earlier in this session. What has not happened is provisioning against a live tenant: no gateway is configured here, so provisionRoles returns nine skipped results and nothing reaches ProjexCloud. The create path is proven against a stubbed client - nine templates, one per role, each carrying only the unaided grants - but no template exists upstream. Closing this is running the boot once with PROJEXCLOUD_GATEWAY_URL set and confirming nine templates in the tenant.

gaps.criterion: Business-unit assignment works for the North Dallas Sales example
gaps.gap: assignPersonaToBusinessUnit is implemented and asserted for the named example - the test drives persona-42 into bu-north-dallas-sales and checks the sdk-persona call shape, an already-assigned persona is treated as success rather than failure so a re-run is safe, and a persona id containing a slash is URL-encoded rather than breaking the path. But it has never run against a real tenant, and the business unit itself does not exist: creating it needs sdk-tenant POST /api/tenants/:id/bus against a reachable gateway, and there is none. So the code path is proven and the actual North Dallas Sales unit is not provisioned. Closing this needs a live tenant: create the BU, assign a persona, and read back GET /api/personas/:persona_id/roles to confirm the scope took.
